outcome: longer-term metabolic risks (for women and children)
cohort: The study discusses pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and their children, focusing on associated risks and management strategies.
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus is a common condition associated with a range of maternal and infant complications, and while screening and treatment can improve outcomes, specific diagnostic thresholds and pharmacotherapy approaches remain controversial.
mod_finding: Caesarean section is listed as one of the maternal complications associated with gestational diabetes mellitus.
